data.body: AC amendment: Specify pr-mode + no GitHub remote behavior. When merge.strategy=pr but gh CLI is not authenticated or no GitHub remote is configured, github-bootstrap.sh must emit: 'WARNING: merge.strategy=pr selected but GitHub remote is unavailable — Ruleset cannot be provisioned. Proceeding as direct-mode for bootstrap.' and continue (fail-open). Exit code for the pr+existing-Ruleset error path: exit 1 (onboarding callers treat exit 1 as a user-gate, not a fatal failure). Add test: test_pr_mode_no_github_remote_emits_warn_and_exits_zero to cover this path.
